papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Shows that simply asking an AI model to write out its step-by-step reasoning in the examples you give it makes it much better at math and logic questions.

papers.title: A Survey of Large Language Models
papers.summary: A very large overview of how LLMs are built and used: how they are trained, adapted to tasks, applied in the real world, and tested.
